description: Weave OSv2 下一轮迭代路线图 — 深度补强与质量收敛。承接 prd-osv2-full-parity-v3.md（US-365~458 已合入）。基于 5 路并行调研，本轮关闭：ObjectSet SSE、RLS/Cell masking CEL、Audit 全覆盖、Function 版本+确定性重放、AIP Block DAG、Pipeline 增量、Parquet 冷存、GeoTemporal/TimeSeries PG 持久化、Saga 补偿策略、Funnel DLQ replay、跨对象乐观锁、TypeClass→Bleve mapping、Scenario→Aggregation 渗透、Quiver 实时数据、JWT 轮换/撤销、OIDC 安全、Tenants schema 隔离、Frontend 35 处 backend gap UI、CLI/SDK 奇偶、OpenAPI 输出、OTel 全链路、Prometheus 规范化、cookbook 全绿。60 个故事分 6 个 Phase (36~41)。详见 tasks/prd-osv2-iteration-roadmap.md。
tddConvention: Red → Green → Refactor。每个 story 先写命名 TestX_Given_State_When_Action_Then_Outcome 的失败测试（go test 表驱动 / Vitest），跑一次明确确认 fail；再写最小实现让测试转绿；再视情重构。算法/性能 story 必附 benchmark（bench/ 目录）；安全 story 必附负向测试；前端 story 必走 dev-browser skill 验证。每 story 提交前必须 go vet ./... + make test 相关包 + make web-build（若涉前端）通过。
bddConvention: 每个 story 除单元测试外，必须附带 BDD 集成测试覆盖功能契约。后端：在 test/e2e/ 或 *_bdd_test.go 写 Given/When/Then 场景，函数名 TestBDD_<Story>_<Scenario>，走真实 chi router + testutil.StartPGContainer，必要时起真实 NATS，断言 HTTP 响应 / DB 状态 / NATS 事件等外部可见行为；前端：*.bdd.test.tsx，Vitest + RTL + MSW 模拟 API。单元测试 + mock 不能替代 BDD。豁免条件：纯文档 / 依赖升级 lockfile-only / 纯格式化 / 仅 migration schema 无代码用法 / 一次性脚本——必须在 commit message 写 `BDD-exempt: <reason>`。任何对 cmd/ pkg/ internal/ web/src/ 的功能代码改动默认不豁免。

userStories.title: HLL / t-digest 精度可配置 + 误差基准
userStories.description: As an analyst, I want to tune approxDistinct precision and verify accuracy on 1M-cardinality data.
acceptanceCriteria: AggregationRequest 接受 hllPrecision (4-18, 默认 14) 与 tdigestCompression (默认 100)
1M 唯一值数据集：HLL p99 误差 < 2%、t-digest percentile 误差 < 1%
扫描行数阈值可配置（默认 1M）触发 APPROXIMATE 标记
userStories.notes: AggregationRequest now carries three new optional knobs — HLLPrecision (json: hllPrecision, range 4..18, default 14), TDigestCompression (json: tdigestCompression, default 100, must be positive finite), ApproximateScanThreshold (json: approximateScanThreshold, default DefaultApproximateScanThreshold=1_000_000). AggregationSpec.Compression (json: compression) is the per-spec override mirroring the existing Spec.Precision (HLL). Plumbing: new approxConfig struct created once per AggregateWithQuery via resolveApproxConfig and threaded through aggregateSimple / aggregateWithGroupBy / aggregateCubeOrRollup / recursiveGroupBy / computeMetrics; runSubAggregations propagates the three request-level knobs onto each childReq so sub-aggregations inherit. computeMetrics picks: spec.Precision > cfg.hllPrecision > DefaultHLLPrecision and spec.Compression > cfg.tdigestCompression > DefaultTDigestCompression. New helpers computeApproxPercentileTDigestC / computeApproxPercentilesTDigestC / newBoundedTDigestC keep the default-compression entry points as thin wrappers (test compatibility) while the compression-aware variants drive every production approximatePercentile call via approxPercentileFromIndex / approxPercentilesFromIndex (signature gained a compression float64 tail param). Scan-threshold logic: AggregateWithQuery computes ScannedRows ONCE post-exclusion and force-marks resp.Accuracy=APPROXIMATE when scanned > effective threshold; nil override uses DefaultApproximateScanThreshold, non-positive override disables. Validation: validateApproxConfig rejects out-of-range hllPrecision + non-positive/NaN/Inf tdigestCompression at AggregateWithQuery entry (clean 400 instead of sketch panic). Tests in pkg/oss/aggregation/us465_precision_test.go: HLL req-level + per-spec override + invalid precision rejection; t-digest req-level (compression=2 degenerate vs default=100 to prove plumbing — silently ignoring compression fails the strict-inequality check) + per-spec override + NaN/Inf/0/negative rejection; scan threshold default-not-fired-at-100-rows + threshold=50-trips-APPROXIMATE-at-100-rows + ComputeUsage.Accuracy mirror + threshold=500-stays-ACCURATE; 1M HLL p99 = 1.56% < 2% over 100 trials; 1M t-digest p99 = 0.9% (at p1) < 1% across 9 probes (p1..p99.9). CI bench gates in bench/aggregation_us465_bench_test.go: TestApproximateDistinct_OneMillion_HLL_US465_P99WithinBudget (25 seeds, p99 < 2%) + TestApproximatePercentile_OneMillion_TDigest_US465_P99WithinBudget (9 probes, p99 < 1%) + BenchmarkApproximateDistinct_OneMillion_US465_HLL + BenchmarkApproximatePercentile_OneMillion_US465_TDigest — bench/coverage_test.go untouched (US-465 not part of the 8 US-441 names; gate is the PRD accuracy budget, not nsPerOp delta). OpenAPI: AggregationRequest gained hllPrecision/tdigestCompression/approximateScanThreshold; AggregationSpec gained compression; canonical api/openapi.yaml + embedded cmd/server/openapi_spec.yaml synced byte-identical, TestContract_EmbeddedSpecMatchesCanonical/AllRoutesDocumented/NoOrphanedSpecPaths all green.

userStories.title: GeoTemporal PG 持久化
userStories.description: As an operator, I want Geo+Time queries persisted in PostgreSQL, not memory-only.
acceptanceCriteria: 时间戳 btree 索引；可选 PostGIS GIST 索引
集成测试：1M 点位空间+时间双过滤 < 100ms
userStories.notes: pkg/geotemporal/pg_store.go + migration 000205 (table + composite series-ts btree) landed in OSV2-301; US-466 hardens the spatial+temporal hot path. New migration 000208 adds (1) a standalone btree on ts for cross-series scans, (2) functional expression indexes on `(position->'coordinates'->>0)::float8` and `...->>1` so the planner can BitmapAnd a bbox predicate without parsing every JSONB payload, and (3) an optional PostGIS GIST index wrapped in a DO block that no-ops on databases without postgis (pgvector CI image has none). New geotemporal.BBox + TimeRange + SpatialTemporalQuerier interface + QueryBBoxRange method on both PgStore and MemoryStore — TimeRange.{Start,End} zero-time means "unbounded on that side"; bbox edges inclusive; positions whose JSONB isn't a GeoJSON Point are silently skipped. Integration tests in pkg/geotemporal/pg_store_spatial_test.go (build tag `integration`): index-presence inspection, mixed-points semantic, zero-time bounds, and the US-466 hard gate — 1M uniform-random points seeded via pgx CopyFrom, 25 sampled queries (random 7-day window × 20×10° bbox), P99 measured at ≈5ms vs the PRD 100ms budget (≈20× headroom); test fails if total rows over all 25 iters is zero so a degenerate seed can't silently "pass" the gate.

userStories.title: TimeSeries time_bucket 聚合 + cagg_5min cron
userStories.description: As an analyst, I want real downsampling backed by TimescaleDB time_bucket_gapfill + last hyperfunction, with a 5min continuous aggregate.
acceptanceCriteria: pkg/timeseries/pg_store.go 真实 SQL 执行 avg/sum/min/max/count + last/first
物化视图 timeseries_cagg_5min，pg_cron 每 5min 刷新（无 pg_cron 时退化 app ticker）
集成测试：1M 点 1h 降采样 → cagg 命中
userStories.notes: PGStore (timeseries_points-backed) gains DownsamplePoints + RefreshCAGG + the free function RunCAGGRefreshLoop so the SDK-facing path has a real time_bucket downsampler with a cagg fast-path. DownsampleAggregation enum gains DownsampleFirst / DownsampleLast (mapped to TimescaleDB first(value, ts) / last(value, ts) hyperfunctions when present; portable DISTINCT ON (bucket) … ORDER BY bucket ASC, ts ASC/DESC fallback when not). New migration 000209_timeseries_cagg.up.sql gates every TimescaleDB statement behind `IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name='timescaledb')` so the pgvector test image stays no-op; when timescaledb is loaded the migration (a) promotes timeseries_points to a hypertable, (b) creates the timeseries_cagg_5min continuous aggregate keyed by (ontology_rid, object_type, primary_key, property, 5min bucket) with avg/min/max/sum/count_value columns filtered by jsonb_typeof(value)='number', (c) registers a `*/5 * * * *` pg_cron job named timeseries-cagg-5min-refresh when pg_cron is available — calling refresh_continuous_aggregate('timeseries_cagg_5min', NULL, NULL). cmd/server boot (`2c. TimeSeries store`) keeps a *PGStore handle on the PG path, calls DetectCAGG once after migrations, and spawns `go RunCAGGRefreshLoop(ctx, store, 5min, ...)` as an idempotent app-side fallback that no-ops when DetectCAGG returns false. PGStore.useCAGG routes >=5min-aligned avg/sum/min/max/count to the cagg via SUM(sum)/NULLIF(SUM(count),0) (weighted avg) + MIN(min)/MAX(max)/SUM(sum)/SUM(count); sub-5min steps and first/last read timeseries_points with `(value::text)::float8` cast guarded by `jsonb_typeof(value)='number'` so non-numeric payloads are silently skipped. Tests: pkg/timeseries/us467_cagg_refresh_test.go (3 unit cases — short-interval ticks-and-stops-on-context, nil/zero/negative interval no-op, refresher errors keep the loop alive and call onError; plus *PGStore satisfies CAGGRefresher); pkg/timeseries/us467_downsample_enum_test.go (NormalizeAggregation accepts first/FIRST/' first '/last/LAST + *PGStore satisfies Downsampler); pkg/timeseries/us467_pg_downsample_test.go (build tag integration) drives TimescaleDB containers through (a) `_Then_CaggExists` migration sanity + DetectCAGG=true, (b) `_Then_ResultsMatchHand` 7-agg table-driven against 6 points (avg=12/15, sum=60/15, min=10/15, max=14/15, count=5/1, first=10/15, last=14/15) — refreshes the cagg before reading to prove the cagg-path query is correct, (c) `_Then_RoutesToRaw` step=30s avg verifying sub-5min always reads raw even with cagg present, (d) the PRD-mandated 1M-point gate `TestPGStore_Given_OneMillionPoints_When_DownsampleOneHour_Then_HitsCagg`: pgx CopyFrom seeds 1M numeric points × 1s in ~4.6s, refresh_continuous_aggregate ~3.2s, DownsamplePoints step=1h avg asserts (i) ~278 buckets (1M/3600 ±1), (ii) zero-buckets guard against silent degenerate, (iii) EXPLAIN of the cagg SQL mentions either `timeseries_cagg_5min` or its `_materialized_hypertable_*` chunk table — and does NOT mention raw `timeseries_points` outside that chunk. Recorded M3 Max numbers: query = 2.7ms over 1M raw, total integration suite 33.6s (1M gate alone ~11s).

userStories.title: Saga 补偿策略明确化（best-effort + DLQ）
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a failed compensation step to not block compensating subsequent steps; all failures land in DLQ.
acceptanceCriteria: 失败补偿写入 funnel_dlq 表
单元测试：3 步全成功 → 中间步失败 → 后续步仍补偿
userStories.notes: PRD 三项验收点逐条落实：(1) SagaOptions + SagaResult 都增 CompensationStrategy（SagaCompensationStrategy enum：best-effort / stop-on-first，empty 默认 best-effort），SagaResult 还新增结构化 FailedCompensations []FailedCompensationRef（字段：StepIndex / StepID / ActionType / CompensateRID / Phase / Reason / DLQID），Phase 取三常量 FailedCompensationPhasePrepare|Commit|Skipped；(2) 失败补偿继续写入既有 action_saga_dlq（PRD 字面 'funnel_dlq' 解读为 saga DLQ 概念 — 仓库里已经有 action_saga_dlq 表 + Funnel 自己另有 OBJECT_EDITS_DLQ NATS 流给 consumer-side 死信用，两者职责不同，US-469 写到 action_saga_dlq）；(3) 单测 us469Fixture 严格复刻 PRD 'A、B、broken-C、failing-D' 场景：stepA/B 有正常 compensator，stepC 的 CompensateActionRID 指向不存在的 RID，stepD 无 compensator 且 prepare 失败触发 rollback；reverse 走 D(no-comp skip) → C(broken, DLQ) → B(ok) → A(ok)。runCompensations 5-tuple 返回重构为 compensationOutcome struct（compensations / appliedEdits / batchID / offset / dlqIDs / failedCompensations）以避免后续故事再扩字段时签名爆炸；signature 多收 reqs []ApplyRequest 与 strategy SagaCompensationStrategy，前者用于 FailedCompensationRef.ActionType 真实回填（不要从 prepared 里读，因为 prepared.ActionType.APIName 是被 resolveActionType 标准化过的 — 客户端读到的应该是它原始传的那个 name）。Best-effort 路径：broken compensator → DLQ row + FailedCompensations entry + continue；commit-batch 失败 → 每个已 build 的 compensator 单独 DLQ + commit-phase FailedCompensations entry。Stop-on-first 路径：第一个 prepare-failure 之后所有剩余 prepared 步骤进 FailedCompensations 但 phase=skipped、DLQID 留空（语义：未尝试不等于失败，不污染 DLQ），且后续 prepare 不再尝试 — 实测 PRD 'stepC broken → stepB/A 留 skipped' 同时 publish=0（没有任何 compensator 进 commit）。Tests in pkg/actions/saga_us469_test.go：6 unit tests + 1 normalize test + 2 handler tests + TestBDD_US469_ThreeStepMiddleFails_BestEffortStillCompensatesRest 端到端走 chi router + memSagaStore 走完 envelope decode + 4-step 状态机 (COMPENSATED, COMPENSATED, COMPENSATION_FAILED, FAILED) + publish=1 验证。Handler 路径在 ApplySagaRequest 加 CompensationStrategy 字段 + 在 NormalizeCompensationStrategy 入口做大小写 / trim / unknown-value userStories.title: Edit-only 属性冲突豁免在 Consumer 生效
userStories.description: As a data engineer, ingest-driven edits should skip version check on edit-only properties to avoid overwriting user edits.
acceptanceCriteria: Consumer 应用 edit 时跳过 edit-only 属性的 version check
测试：用户改 A.title → ingest 不覆盖
userStories.notes: 现状盘点：US-027 已经把 SetEditOnlyField 钩子 + preserveEditOnlyFields 过滤器在 pkg/funnel 里落地（ingest CREATE/MODIFY 上把 editOnly 属性从 incoming Properties 里 strip 掉 + fetch-merge 当前 bleve 值回来，保证 bleve upsert 不会清掉用户值），但 production main.go 从未调用 SetEditOnlyField，所以真实部署里 ingest 仍然会覆盖 IsEditOnly=true 属性 —— test/foundry_parity/us027_edit_only.json '观察笔记' 字面写着 'Production main.go does NOT yet wire SetEditOnlyField against the live OMS schema'，US-472 就是补这块 prod-wiring gap。设计：在 cmd/server 新建 editOnlyResolver 适配器（narrow editOnlyResolverRepo interface — ListOntologies/ListObjectTypes/ListProperties 三方法），缓存 (objectType APIName) -> set[property APIName] 的 IsEditOnly=true 集合在 sync.RWMutex 保护的 map 里；funnel SetEditOnlyField 回调签名 func(objectType, field string) bool 缺少 ontology 维度，所以两个 ontology 同 OT APIName 不同 IsEditOnly 时做 OR 聚合（over-protection 比静默漏写安全）。Refresh 走 'ListOntologies 全失败回滚到旧 cache + per-OT ListProperties 失败 log+skip 部分 cache' 两层 degradation；runEditOnlyRefreshLoop 是标准 reaper-style 驱动（ticker + onError 回调 + ctx 退出），main.go 启动时同步跑一次 Refresh 再起 5min loop，degraded boot（无 OmsRepo）天然 no-op。Unit tests（cmd/server/edit_only_resolver_test.go，11 个）覆盖：nil repo/nil receiver 都返 false、Refresh 只缓存 IsEditOnly=true 的 field、unknown OT/field 返 false、跨 ontology OR 聚合、per-OT 错误 swallow + 全局 ListOntologies 错误 bubble up、二次 Refresh 原子 swap cache（admin 清掉 flag → 再次 Refresh 后 false）、ticker loop 转动并 ctx-stop、nil/0 interval 立刻退出、onError 后继续转。BDD（cmd/server/edit_only_resolver_bdd_test.go，integration tag，2 scenario）走真 testcontainers PG + 真 oms.NewPGRepository + 真 funnel.NewConsumer：(a) Given 用户 CREATE 后 ingest 用 STRICTLY NEWER timestamp 写 notes='SPAM' → resolver 通过 prod-shape 链路把 IsEditOnly=true 透传给 consumer → 最终 bleve doc notes='VIP'（用户值保留）status='shipped'（非 editOnly 字段照常更新），用 strictly-newer 时间戳确保 US-021 timestamp guard 无法掩盖 wiring 漏配；(b) admin 清掉 IsEditOnly flag → Refresh 后 IsEditOnly 真返回 false，证明 5min tick 让 schema 变更不需要重启。一个 PG fixture corner：Property.Status 在 INSERT 走 DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'，但 UpdateProperty 是全列重写，Go 零值 '' 会 trip properties_status_check (SQLSTATE 23514) —— 写 update-flag BDD 时 Status 必须显式赋 'ACTIVE'。Files changed: cmd/server/edit_only_resolver.go (新建), cmd/server/edit_only_resolver_test.go (新建), cmd/server/edit_only_resolver_bdd_test.go (新建), cmd/server/main.go (US-261 marking inheritance 后插入 US-472 wiring 块).
